meta.title: Vida Novi Sad — The Feel Good Place | healthy food, brunch & coffee
meta.description: Vida Novi Sad — The Feel Good Place since 2016. Brunch, healthy bowls, coconut smoothie bowls, wraps, fresh juices, matcha and coffee. Rumenačka 148a, open daily 07–23h. Order or book a table.

morning.lead: Good morning. Coffee, breakfast and brunch — slowly, in the sun.

evening.lead: Evenings on the terrace: spritz, coconut smoothie bowls and hot chocolate.

about.p1: Vida is “The Feel Good Place” in Novi Sad — since 2016.
about.p2: Healthy food that's also fun: brunch, bowls, coconut smoothie bowls, wraps, fresh juices, matcha and good coffee. In the evening — cocktails on the terrace.
